title: Cosan Receives Binding Proposals for Stake in Rumo
seoTitle: Cosan Receives Binding Proposals for Rumo Stake
subtitle: Company evaluates alternatives to reduce debt and leverage.
excerpt: Cosan reported that it is receiving binding proposals from interested parties for its stake in railway operator Rumo.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Cosan reported that it is receiving binding proposals from potential interested parties for its stake in Rumo, the freight railway operator. The move comes against a backdrop of high leverage and the pursuit of strategies to improve operations and debt levels.

Evaluation Process and Binding Proposals

The company reiterated that it has been moving forward with the process of evaluating alternatives for the sale of part of its stake in the operator, aligned with its deleveraging strategy. However, the company pointed out that no decision has been made so far regarding the actual execution of a transaction. Cosan CEO Marcelo Martins had stated in a conference call that the company continued in talks with interested parties, while press reports indicate an intention to negotiate about fifteen percent of Rumo.

Financial Overview and Quarterly Balance Sheet

The operation under study takes place amid Cosan's indebtedness. In its reported financial statement, the company closed the second quarter with a net loss attributable to controlling shareholders of three hundred and twenty million reais, representing an improvement compared to the same period previously. The reduction in losses came from a tightening of financial and corporate expenses and an improvement in equity income.

Restructuring and Recent Structural Changes

In addition to the talks regarding Rumo, the company announced a series of restructurings. Among the measures are changes in the board of directors, the exit from the New York Stock Exchange, and shareholding simplification at Grupo Radar, a subsidiary focused on the acquisition and management of rural properties. In June, the hiring of a financial advisor was formalized to evaluate alternatives regarding the stake held in the railway operator.

The Importance of Rumo in the Portfolio

Rumo stands out as one of the main assets in Cosan's portfolio and holds strategic relevance for the flow of the country's agribusiness production. The holding company owns a significant stake in the freight operator, which means that any shareholding change attracts the attention of the market and investors interested in the sector.

With information from Folha de S.Paulo, VEJA.
